addIdeaHint: Paste a link to import details, or fill in the fields yourself.

archives.title: Archived ideas
archives.hint: Archived ideas no longer appear in the shared list. You can restore them to the list at any time.
archives.emptyHint: Ideas you archive will appear here.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.empty: No gifts have been reserved yet.
reservations.cancelBody: This gift will be available to reserve again.

confirm.deleteIdeaBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted from the list. This can’t be undone.
confirm.leaveBody: You’ll no longer be able to edit this list with this account.
confirm.regenBody: The old link will no longer let people join the list.
confirm.clearPasswordBody: Anyone with the link will be able to view the list again.
confirm.removeMemberBody: They won’t be able to edit the list until you invite them again.

categories.typesHint: Select a category to rename it. To add one, enter its name and select “Add”.
categories.peopleHint: Add the people or groups receiving gifts. Select a name to edit it. A recipient used by a gift idea can’t be removed.

share.title: Share your list
share.description: Share your wishes with loved ones, or invite someone to manage the list with you.
share.readDescription: This link lets people view the list and reserve gifts. It doesn’t let them edit gift ideas.
share.collabDescription: Anyone who opens this link while logged in can join and edit the list. Only share it with people you want to invite.
share.inviteEmailDescription: They’ll receive a link to join and edit the list. They’ll need to log in or create an account.
share.regenerateHint: The previous invitation link will stop working. Existing members are not affected.
share.readPasswordHint: Without a password, anyone with the link can view the list. With a password of at least 8 characters, they’ll also need to enter it.
share.readPasswordSet: Your list is password-protected. Entering a new one replaces it.
share.membersDescription: Members can add, edit, and remove gift ideas on this list.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Categories, recipients, and sensitive actions on this list.
settings.appearanceHint: Customize the title, description, colors, and illustration on your shared list.
settings.subtitle: Description (optional)
settings.subtitleHint: This text appears below the list name. Leave it blank to show no description.
settings.colorsHint: The primary color is used for buttons and the illustrated gift box. The accent color is used for alerts and the lid. The star color is also used for the ribbon.
settings.coverImageHint: Paste an image URL. Leave this blank to show the gift illustration in your list’s colors.
settings.dangerHint: Deleting this wish list is permanent.

form.name: Gift name
form.priorityHint: From 1 to 5: more stars mean you’d love this gift more.
form.aiBody: These fields were prefilled using a language model. Review them before saving.
form.aiCo2: About {{grams}} g CO₂e — roughly equivalent to {{beef}} g of red meat
form.aiDisclaimer: Indicative orders of magnitude, not a certified carbon footprint.

accordion.hint: Open a category to see its ideas. The arrows reorder categories. The menu moves an idea.
